scope: external synthetic independent research only; never native training, owner loop, accepted refs, merge or deployment
hypothesis: A learner retaining three old learned pair factors and identifying one previously unprovided fourth-order effect by residualized intervention fitting reduces cold prediction MSE >=5% versus strongest fully fitted same-dictionary conventional learner on fresh unseen interventions, without loss of OLD functional readout.
candidate: Learn 3 OLD supports by OMP on 28 pair-parity terms, store old frozen checkpoint, fit NEW Ridge on OLD supports and find a new fourth-order parity feature via residualized correlation over 70 authored quadruple Walsh candidates; jointly Ridge-refit 3 old supports plus discovered quad on the same 40 NEW observations.

dataset.generated_by: original author-owned deterministic intervention generator ENERGY-65 v1, no external content or protected native evaluator
dataset.new_mechanism: reweighted old factors plus one unseen 4-bit parity, two 4-bit parity, or one unseen 5-bit parity outside candidate degree-4 grammar
dataset.leakage_guard: planted truth and all held labels held by scorer, never supplied to model fit; oracle only a diagnostic and not a conventional comparator
dataset.novelty_limit: The 70 4-way Walsh feature grammar is fully researcher-authored, and the fifth-order mechanism is deliberately outside it. This is not unrestricted invention.

info_budget: Every method observes exactly the same 60 old and 40 new consequence labels; each original causal action assignment appears once across five disjoint sets. Full matched controls use same pair/quad grammar and new data; observation parity does not mean equal compute.
strongest_controls: Train-only 3-fold CV ElasticNet alpha .005/.025/.08 L1 .85 on candidate OLD supports + all 70 quads and separately on entire 98-term pair/quad bank; fully fitted OMP4 and Ridge1 on same full bank; train-label-weighted softmax frozen-old/fresh OMP. Never count oracle in eligible competition.
compute_runtime: Python3.13.5 single-thread NumPy2.3.5 scipy1.17.0 scikit-learn1.8.0; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; one 24-world screen then independent separate refit audit and deterministic replay. No paid APIs, official runner, physical energy measurement.

dev_excluded.meaning: pre-source-freeze development smoke, exploratory and ineligible

metrics: Per-world MSE OLD/NEW/COLD on 36 withheld actions; pooled across worlds, per-seed/family COLD MSE, correct quad identity in single-new-quad worlds, exact old prediction retention, model-selection CV alpha and independent refit consistency.

frozen_gates.cold_gain5_vs_best_strong_control: Pooled candidate COLD MSE <= 0.95*minimum pooled COLD MSE of same_support_elasticnet, full_bank_elasticnet, full_bank_omp4, full_bank_ridge, softmax_old_fresh.
frozen_gates.cold_gain5_vs_full_elasticnet: Pooled candidate COLD MSE <= 0.95 * full_bank_elasticnet COLD MSE.
frozen_gates.cold_gain5_vs_matched_elasticnet: Pooled candidate COLD MSE <= 0.95 * same_support_elasticnet COLD MSE.
frozen_gates.each_seed_better_than_best_other: Candidate COLD MSE strictly below best other eligible fully trained control on EACH independent screen seed.
frozen_gates.each_family_nondegradation10pct: Candidate COLD MSE <=1.1*best other conventional COLD MSE in EACH mechanism family.
frozen_gates.old_retention_exact: All candidate OLD held predictions equal frozen-old readout vector at machine precision.
frozen_gates.novel_quad_recovered_60pct: Exact candidate quad identity equals planted quadruple in at least 60% of single-new-quad cases.
frozen_gates.shuffled_negative20pct: Candidate COLD MSE <=.80*shuffled-new-label negative COLD MSE.

decisions.SCREEN_PROMISING: ALL four critical screening gates and >=8 of 9 gates PASS, complete 24-world evidence and independent original-receipt audit PASS. Only then eligible for separate frozen 36-world primary; never native science acceptance.
decisions.SCREEN_NO_GO: Any critical gate FAIL, or <8/9 PASS, with valid complete original audit. Stop and preserve negative; leave reserved primary unused.
decisions.INVALID: Source/prereg AFTER prospective scoring, drift in code/seed/feature budget, planted hidden labels leaked to model, missing fully fitted matched controls, overlapping action assignments, invalid re-fit audit or incomplete receipt.
decisions.UNVERIFIED: Missing screen results or incomplete audit, not a scientific verdict.

freeze: No post-screen candidate hyperparameter, threshold, grammar, seed, policy or capacity modification. Do not relabel negative as infrastructure failure. Exact source tar/manifest committed before this prereg and both precede fresh scores.
research_owner: external contributor evidence only; Yggdrasil retains native qualification/acceptance authority
